title: Face Sculpt Lifting and Hydrating Moisturizer
descriptionHtml:
✓ Good for: Uneven Texture✓ Fragrance Free✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Good for: Loss of firmness✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Cream Formula

What it is: A lightweight gel-cream moisturizer with built-in roller tool that rapidly lifts appearance, visibly defines, and intensely hydrates skin for up to 24 hours, creating a dewy base.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily


Formulation: Cream


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Inst'tight Complex: Quickly reduces the look of fine lines and firm skin.

- Glycerin: Hydrates and visibly plumps the skin.

- Provitamins: Calms and reduces redness.


Ingredient Callouts: It is also gluten-free and cruelty-free.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:
-Use as part of morning and evening skincare routine.

-Squeeze a grape-size amount of formula and distribute around the face.

-Use the roller applicator to massage into the skin, gently rolling in circular motions upwards and outwards.

-Use fingertips to smooth in excess product including around the forehead.

-Wipe applicator clean after each use.

Ingredients+
-Inst’Tight Complex: Helps to immediately reduce the look of fine lines and visibly firm skin.
-Glycerin: Intensely hydrates and plumps the appearance of skin.
-Pro-Vitamins: Help to calm the skin and reduce redness.

Aqua/Water/Eau, Glycerin, Erythritol, Isononyl Isononanoate, Diglycerin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Pentylene Glycol, Dicaprylyl Carbonate, Diisostearoyl Polyglyceryl-3 Dimer Dilinoleate, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/VP Copolymer, Panthenol, Polyglyceryl-3 Methylglucose Distearate, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Caprylic/Capric/Myristic/Stearic Triglyceride, Aminomethyl Propanol, Boron Nitride, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Hydroxypropyl Methylcellulose Stearoxy Ether, Caprylyl Glycol, Cetearyl Olivate, Glyceryl Acrylate/Acrylic Acid Copolymer, Cetearyl Alcohol, Sorbitan Olivate, Saccharomyces Ferment Filtrate, Polyglyceryl-10 Oleate, Polyglyceryl-5 Oleate, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate, Sodium Phytate, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil, Dipropylene Glycol, Gleditsia Triacanthos Seed Extract, PVM/MA Copolymer, Glyceryl Caprylate, Albatrellus Confluens (Mushroom) Extract, Hydrolyzed Vegetable Protein, Tocopherol, Trehalose.
